notes:
Accountability emails need no setup, and you're told when a report doesn't get through

Reports now go through a small Kairos email server (server/reports, on Resend), so you only type
your contact's address; your own account with an app password is still an option. If a report
can't be sent, the app says so once and the Accountability tab shows why until one gets through,
and changing settings retries straight away.
